business_summary: SUNNEXTA GROUP Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as an outsourcing service company in Japan. It operates in three segments: Corporate Housing Management Business, Condominium Management Business, and Incubation Business. The company offers corporate housing administrative work related to company housing, dormitories, and parking lots; BPO services for human resources and general affairs, and housing system consultation services; and cost reduction services. It also provides apartment management services, real estate-related services, and reform and renovation services, as well as monitoring security services, insurance agency services, and condominium management digital transformation support services. SUNNEXTA GROUP Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
